policy: Every known limitation is classified; only internal_mandatory items become implementation work for horizontal product completion.

items.title: Complete ECS Y1-O2 evidence scope is incomplete.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.9.0 with generated four-stream evidence and independent semantic verification; native P1 timing and zero-allocation qualification remain separate.

items.title: Y1-O4 proxy has no final accept/reject decision.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.11.0 by formally rejecting Y1-O4 as a runtime claim; the historical uncertainty and RAA paths remain research/shadow evidence only.

items.title: Global numerical containment and overflow certificate is open.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.11.0 by rejecting the global composed certificate and accepting only the full-storage-domain checked Q32.32 primitive contract plus explicitly scoped evidence surfaces.

items.title: General oblique-tree solver is not fully certified.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.11.0 by separating exact rational small-tree, finite-grid-only, residual-only and connected operational non-certified dispositions; no general solver certificate is claimed.

items.title: Real reference transport for distributed operation is absent.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.10.0 by the bounded UDP loopback reference adapter outside canonical state.

items.title: Current HMAC protocol provides integrity/authenticity but not confidentiality.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.13.0 by explicitly limiting the HMAC packet to integrity/authenticity and requiring authenticated confidential transport, nonzero channel binding and an external production provider.

items.title: Forward secrecy is not provided.
items.normative_decision: Document supported threat model; do not claim forward secrecy unless a new protocol is approved.

items.title: No concrete asymmetric authentication/PKI provider exists.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.13.0 by removing the included production asymmetric State Signature claim. External provider interfaces remain without implying algorithm, PKI, custody or non-repudiation.

items.title: Persistent key custody and rotation storage are not provided by the product.
items.normative_decision: Publish provider contract and deployment requirements; HSM/TPM remains deployment-specific.

items.title: CSPRNG and trusted time are supplied by the host.
items.normative_decision: Document and test rejection of invalid host values.

items.title: Authorization is role-based rather than command/entity-granular.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.13.0 by bounded deny-by-default authorization over command, entity, authenticated origin, role, key identifier/epoch, time interval and confidential channel context.

items.title: Volumetric DDoS protection is not in-process.
items.normative_decision: Keep edge mitigation outside the D-Core and document capacity assumptions.

items.title: A compromised host process is outside the in-process SDK threat boundary.
items.normative_decision: State explicitly; do not claim isolation from a privileged or compromised host.

items.title: Session/network structures are not generally thread-safe.
items.normative_decision: Retain owner-thread contract and add conformance tests; no silent thread-safety claim.

items.title: Rollback cannot undo irreversible external effects.
items.normative_decision: Accepted in 1.12.0: rollback never claims to undo an irreversible committed effect; the official prepare/confirm/commit/compensate contract, idempotency conflict checks and reference tests make the host boundary explicit.

items.title: Host SDK does not expose every implemented product capability.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.14.0 by mapping every public horizontal claim to an installed SDK or official tool and generating public claims only from the verified ledger.

items.title: Host SDK is static-library only.
items.normative_decision: Decide whether shared distribution is commercially required; static delivery remains valid if documented.

items.title: No cross-toolchain C++ ABI guarantee exists.
items.normative_decision: C ABI remains the stable boundary.

items.title: Year-1 candidate contract and Host ABI freeze language conflict.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.9.0: Host C ABI 1.0 is public binary ABI; Year-1 contract constants govern internal replay/schema and source-level C++ compatibility.

items.title: Public canonical state/Host ABI is specialized to Body/InputCommand.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.10.0 by the domain-neutral ReplicaAdapter boundary with explicit schema id and opaque correction payload; the Body adapter remains one implementation and canonical authority is unchanged.

items.title: Time-travel diff and Merkle localization are Body-schema-specific.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.12.0 by declaring WorldState v1 as the sole product-promised canonical schema and covering frame plus every Body field in semantic diff, canonical SHA-256 and Merkle localization.

items.title: Automatic budget instrumentation is not universal.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.12.0 by declaring nine mandatory operational paths and emitting correlated automatic budget samples whenever tracing is enabled for each supported path.

items.title: Divergence comparison is host-triggered; no reference distributed coordinator exists.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.10.0 by TwoInstanceCoordinator with schema/frame checks, real transport, official rollback correction and mandatory post-reconciliation comparison.

items.title: Trace/time-travel retention is bounded and non-durable.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.12.0 by retaining the bounded live debugger while adding an explicit append-only durable recorder with restart recovery, atomic publication, SHA-256 chaining and fail-closed verification.

items.title: View Lab is static/offline and not a live debugger.
items.normative_decision: Do not market live remote debugging unless a separate tool is built.

items.title: Evidence chains are not automatically persisted or anchored externally.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.12.0 by the official durable recorder and independently verifiable head digest; external anchoring remains an explicit deployment responsibility and is not claimed as product-supplied.

items.title: No production asymmetric State Signature provider is implemented.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.13.0 with the same normative removal as LIM-008; the original positive claim is prohibited and the provider remains deployment-specific.

items.title: WORM/notary infrastructure is external.
items.normative_decision: Provide adapter contract; do not claim external immutability without deployment evidence.

items.title: Support bundles have integrity but no built-in confidentiality.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.13.0 by canonical protected-bundle framing through an external AEAD provider, authenticated metadata binding, verified opening and explicit secure transfer/storage deployment responsibility.

items.title: Fuzzing is not continuous and coverage-guided across the product.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.14.0 with two continuous 120-second LLVM libFuzzer release gates covering hostile network-packet and session-handshake byte ingress.

items.title: Sanitizer coverage is limited to subsets.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.14.0 by executing ASan and UBSan over the complete supported release test surface, including the installed SDK consumer.

items.title: Blocking industrial static analysis is not evidenced.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.14.0 by a blocking clang-tidy gate over all 64 supported implementation units with one scoped and documented third-party false-positive suppression.

items.title: SBOM, release signing and secure update process are absent.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.14.0 with an SPDX 2.3 SBOM, deterministic provenance, SHA-256 manifests, fail-closed update policy and two keyless Sigstore bundles verified against Fulcio and public Rekor.

items.title: No published continuous integration pipeline reproduces the full matrix.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.14.0 by the committed GitHub Actions matrix that reproduced Windows clang-cl, Linux GCC/Clang, sanitizer, fuzzing, static-analysis and release gates from one clean source commit.

items.title: Distribution is fragmented as base plus ChangeSets.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.14.0 by one cumulative deterministic source ZIP; base-plus-patches distribution is prohibited by the release contract.

items.title: Commercial entitlement/licensing enforcement is absent.
items.normative_decision: Closed in 1.14.0 by selecting distribution-and-contract-controlled entitlement. No runtime licensing decision or entitlement server enters canonical state, and no redistribution permission is inferred.

items.title: No sector adapters are included.
items.normative_decision: Adapters are separate products and do not block horizontal D-Core completion.

items.title: Hard real-time, WCET and safety runtime are absent.
items.normative_decision: Required only by a future certified vertical; not a D-Core horizontal promise.

items.title: Consensus, quorum and complete distributed replication are absent.
items.normative_decision: Explicitly exclude them; distributed proof uses a reference coordinator, not a database.

items.title: Independent cryptographic/security audit has not occurred.
items.normative_decision: Prepare artifacts internally; completion requires an independent reviewer.

items.title: Sector certifications and compliance attestations have not occurred.
items.normative_decision: Never claim certification before the relevant external process is complete.
